claims: Carrie Anne Fleming was born in 1974.
Carrie Anne Fleming was a Canadian actress.
Carrie Anne Fleming played Karen Singer in Supernatural.
Karen Singer is Bobby Singer's wife.
Carrie Anne Fleming appeared in three episodes across seasons 2, 5, and 7 of Supernatural.
Carrie Anne Fleming appeared in Supernatural S02E01 "In My Time of Dying" as a nurse.
Carrie Anne Fleming appeared in Supernatural S05E15 "Dead Men Don't Wear Plaid".
Carrie Anne Fleming appeared in Supernatural S07E10 "Death's Door".
In Supernatural Season 5, Karen Singer was brought back from the dead as a zombie.
In Supernatural, Bobby Singer killed Karen Singer again when she became dangerous.
Jim Beaver praised Carrie Anne Fleming as a "beautiful costar".
Carrie Anne Fleming played Candy Baker on iZombie
